title: 🎥 Latest Update on the Oil Tanker Targeted Near Kharg Island
text:
🎥 Latest Update on the Oil Tanker Targeted Near Kharg Island"

"🔹 According to investigations by Fars News Agency, the operation to extinguish the fire on the oil tanker that was targeted near Kharg Island on Saturday has concluded."

"🔹 All crew members of the ship are in good health, and so far, the incident has not resulted in any oil spills."

"🔹 Today, various teams have been dispatched to the scene to assess the condition of the tanker and make decisions regarding its relocation.
